description: A group of knowledgeable and competent photographers with a Delhi base, VS Photography Studio offers customized still solutions. As its name implies, VS Photography Studio seeks to elegantly record all of your lovely moments. In order to accurately capture a celebration that is known for pleasure, laughing, and vibrant ceremonies, VS Photography Studio avoids staged poses and is a supporter of spontaneous, exciting moments. VS Photography Studio will make sure that your wedding photographs are imaginative, elegant, and timeless by focusing on producing images that are full of real events and emotions. description: Picture Mantra is a photography company based in Delhi NCR. They believe, ‘We don’t just click photos; we paint memories, memories which you can cherish for a long time, memories to bring a smile whenever you are in need of it.’ They understand that the images they create put impact directly or indirectly on the way their clients and their brand are perceived. Being the firm believer of the fact that ‘Photography is not a profession, it’s a passion’ they click every single moment of your fairytale wedding in most striking and stylish fashion. And when one is driven insanely by passion of capturing emotions, moods and moments with the click of camera, the outcome is indeed a memory for life. description: The Delhi based Khushi Film Art has been in the wedding photography industry for the long run now. This team ensures to capture raw and genuine moments of love in your wedding day without you even noticing their presence. They aim to capture fleeting moments of your wedding day that unfold as the day goes on for you to relive forever. This team specializes in candid photography and is always on the lookout for beautiful and joyous moments to capture and show them in their natural light. Their actual strength lies in creating artistic, expressive and whimsical images which makes their style unique. They provide around 300-500 processed pictures to cherish for a lifetime.

description: Mountain Roots Production, a Delhi-based company, specialises in documentary and traditional styles of shooting. To ensure that no moment of your nuptial ceremony is missed, the team focuses on the minute details of the occasion to give you memories in the form of enjoyable pictures that you can cherish for life. With state-of-the-art equipment such as Canon Mark III 6D, Canon Mark III 5D, Canon C300 and drones, sliders, and jibs, the team captures all the special moments of your wedding in high-definition videos and photos. Mountain Roots Production's wedding package includes a wide range of customised solutions regarding all your videography and photography needs. From engagement shoot to providing a slideshow on your reception, all your events will be ideally covered and the outcome will be presented in a well-edited, customised digital album. Since their inception in 2013, they aim to create audio-visual concepts for wedding. They pledge to comprehensively research our Clients goals, ethics and history to produce diverse story lines and concepts best suited to Client’s vision.

description: Gayatri Japam is a religious ceremony practiced by Hindus through chanting of the Gayatri Mantra. It is closely related to Upakarma or Avani Avittam especially in Vedic communities. Gayatri Japam is usually observed on the day after Yajurveda Upakarma. On that day devotees recite the Gayatri Mantra with focus and devotion. In 2026, Gayatri Japam will take place on August 28, a day after Yajurveda Upakarma on August 27. The Gayatri Mantra is one of the respected mantras used in Hindu traditions. It is a prayer in the Rigveda dedicated to Savitr – the divine light. The prayer seeks power of divine light to inspire our intellect. Thus, Gayatri Japam is not only a repetition of a mantra but a practice of turning one's mind to knowledge and inner peace. Why Is Gayatri Japam Celebrated? Gayatri Japam is celebrated as a continuation of the spiritual practices done during Upakarma. The Upakarma ceremony has historically been associated with renewal of Vedic studies and changing of the sacred thread. The next day is designated for the repeated chanting of the Gayatri Mantra. The major significance of Gayatri Japam is to seek wisdom and purity of thoughts and mind. The practice is a reminder of the need to apply knowledge appropriately and keep the mind engaged in good deeds. Moreover, Gayatri Japam is also considered to be a time of renewing of commitment to spiritual practices. Traditionally, the Gayatri Mantra is chanted 108 or 1008 times, depending on family tradition, Vedic practice, or personal guidelines. The chanting is usually done in the morning after observing necessary rituals. Importance of the Gayatri Mantra The Gayatri Mantra is very important for Hindus and is respected in their spiritual practice. The significance of this mantra lies in its simple meaning. It is a prayer to divine light to inspire the intellect and show the correct path. Hence, Gayatri Japam is associated with learning, wisdom and a disciplined mind. description: The Wedding Frames is a team of talented professional photographers and cinematographers based in Delhi. With a lot of experience in the industry, almost 7 years now, they have created some of the most aesthetically pleasing wedding films and photo albums nationally and internationally. They believe in making your wedding very memorable by treating you as the star cast of their videos and pictures. Their style can be described as photojournalistic and artistic and they make sure to add an extra element of innovation to exceed your expectations and represent your personality. They specialize in candid photography, traditional photography and pre-wedding shoots. They also travel outstation to cover destination weddings. Understanding the importance of your special occasion and bringing the magic out in your photographs is what they aim for. They provide about 700 edited pictures to their clients. They strive to make your special day although more special by capturing your memorable moments with utmost precision. Understanding the emotions that go into your wedding day, they ensure to capture all the precious moments, and become a part of your special day by adding their personalised touch. With the knowledge of latest camera techniques, they put their heart and soul in preserving your precious memories that you will cherish for a lifetime, making them a great choice for your wedding. They have cinematographers and photographers who have close to 15 years of experience in the industry and have worked with TV and film production houses like Balaji Telefilms. Colors, Star Plus, etc. So go ahead and make memories, because their team promises you of capturing those special moments for you to live them over again through their beautiful pictures, making them an ideal pick.

description: Cupcake Productions was co-founded by Shruti Khanna & Jayant Chhabra, a Delhi based husband-wife duo, their passion for love inspired them to start capturing weddings in an artistic manner.
